content.heroHeading: Take a deep breath. Find your way.
content.heroIntro: A gentle, guided moment to pause, explore what’s on your mind, and discover what kind of support could feel right for you.
content.journeyTitle: Find an experience that feels right.
content.journeyIntro: A few quick questions can help narrow the options—whether you’re after something calming, reflective, or more spiritual. No beliefs or previous experience needed.
content.privacyNote: We don’t ask for health details or contact information. Your answers stay in this page and aren’t saved.
content.resultNote: Prototype suggestions use the supplied catalogue details. Confirm current availability and suitability before booking. Your answers stay in this page and aren’t saved.
content.recommendationTitle: These experiences may fit what you’re looking for.
content.recommendationMessage: These example products and sample plans are matched to your answers for the demo. They’re illustrative only, with unknown availability, and aren’t bookable offers.
content.noMatchTitle: Your preferences are clear; the fit isn’t.
content.noMatchMessage: The supplied catalogue doesn’t describe an eligible option that matches this combination, so Spirit won’t guess. You can try another path or browse the catalogue when it’s connected.
